authority_boundary.owner_basis: The Product Owner ratified Q1 through Q6 and Q7 through Q13. The exact V4 projection-resolution receipt controls this descendant.
authority_boundary.permitted_effect: May be bound by a later acyclic correction-map descendant and presented for a separate exact-byte Product Owner ratification decision.
not_authorized: C1 concurrence restart, C2 concurrence restart, and C3 concurrence restart before separate exact-byte Product Owner ratification
F2 restart, repair, commit, push, and workflow
editing accepted F1 bytes and editing the stopped uncommitted F2 draft
adding, removing, renumbering, and changing valid semantics of any official MCP vector
adapter-dependent mapping subject-digest qualification and authenticated mapping collision qualification

closed_fixture_semantics.one_id_one_leaf: Each canonical fixture ID below identifies exactly one executable scenario. Ranges and prose bundles are expanded; an alias never creates a second fixture.
closed_fixture_semantics.input: The named request plus protected-record input is encoded in its unique canonical spelling at the stated boundary values. A negative input changes only the field named by that leaf.
closed_fixture_semantics.schedule: Steps are ordered left to right. A named crash occurs after the preceding durable plus physical step and before the following step, followed by a process restart when stated.
closed_fixture_semantics.expected: The implementation fixture must freeze exact canonical response plus six-field canonical error-envelope bytes and the durable/physical post-state described by the leaf. Message, details, raw secret, raw path, SQL, stack, exception text, and external subject are forbidden.
closed_fixture_semantics.mutation: zero means no authority row, event, anchor, file, secret-reveal, idempotency-result, and success-activity mutation. A named allowed mutation is exhaustive; every unnamed mutation is forbidden.
closed_fixture_semantics.closed_error_projection: Where a leaf names CURSOR_STALE, it projects to GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY. Invalid canonical/schema inputs project to GKOS_P6_INVALID_PARAMS unless the leaf names a narrower existing code. No new error code is introduced.
